mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.split_method, s.total_amount, s.settlement_status, creator.display_name AS requested_by, a.appointment_name AS gathering_name, COALESCE(t.memo, a.appointment_name) AS merchant_name, t.transfer_number, payer.display_name AS paid_by FROM settlements s JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = s.source_transfer_id JOIN members creator ON creator.member_id = s.created_by_member_id JOIN members payer ON payer.member_id = s.payer_member_id WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ))
SELECT item_name FROM settlement_items WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY source_order, settlement_item_id

SELECT DISTINCT t.transfer_id, am.appointment_id, t.initiator_member_id AS payer_member_id, t.amount, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places, tr.title AS journey_name, a.appointment_name AS gathering_name, a.appointment_name AS merchant_name, t.completed_at AS paid_at, payer.display_name AS payer_name FROM wallet_transfers t JOIN wallet_ledger_entries le ON le.transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = tel.appointment_member_id JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id LEFT JOIN trips tr ON tr.trip_id = tel.trip_id JOIN members payer ON payer.member_id = t.initiator_member_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = t.currency_code LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.source_transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND s.settlement_id IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC, t.transfer_id DESC

SELECT am.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, m.display_name FROM appointment_members am JOIN members m ON m.member_id = am.member_id WHERE am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY am.appointment_member_id

SELECT s.settlement_id, a.appointment_name AS title, sm.share_amount AS amount, s.split_method, s.settlement_status FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id JOIN settlements s ON s.settlement_id = sm.settlement_id JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.created_by_member_id != #{memberId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.requested_at DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id, a.appointment_name AS title, s.receivable_amount AS amount, s.split_method, s.settlement_status FROM settlements s JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id WHERE s.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.requested_at DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT t.transfer_id, am.appointment_id, t.initiator_member_id AS payer_member_id, t.amount, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places FROM wallet_transfers t JOIN wallet_ledger_entries le ON le.transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = tel.appointment_member_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = t.currency_code WHERE t.transfer_id = #{sourceTransferId} AND t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT appointment_member_id, member_id FROM appointment_members WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY appointment_member_id

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, requested_at, memo, version FROM settlements WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount FROM settlements WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, requested_at, memo, version FROM settlements WHERE created_by_member_id = #{createdByMemberId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, requested_at, memo, version FROM settlements WHERE source_transfer_id = #{sourceTransferId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sm.settlement_member_id, sm.settlement_id, sm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status, sm.paid_transfer_id FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlements ( appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, requested_at, memo ) VALUES ( #{appointmentId}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{payerMemberId}, #{sourceTransferId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{settlementStatus}, #{splitMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{payerShareAmount}, #{receivableAmount}, #{requestedAt}, #{memo} )

INSERT INTO settlement_members (settlement_id, appointment_member_id, share_amount, request_status) VALUES
(#{member.settlementId}, #{member.appointmentMemberId}, #{member.shareAmount}, #{member.requestStatus})

INSERT INTO settlement_items (settlement_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order) VALUES
(#{item.settlementId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.lineTotal}, #{item.sourceOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE settlements SET settlement_status = 'REQUESTED', requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND settlement_status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id SET sm.request_status = CASE WHEN am.member_id = #{memberId} THEN 'NOT_REQUESTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, sm.sent_at = CASE WHEN am.member_id = #{memberId} THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sm.request_status = 'NOT_REQUESTED' AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_analysis_id, source_transfer_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, original_file_name, analysis_status, recognized_total FROM receipt_analyses WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT receipt_analysis_id, source_transfer_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, original_file_name, analysis_status, recognized_total FROM receipt_analyses WHERE source_transfer_id = #{sourceTransferId} AND created_by_member_id = #{createdByMemberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE receipt_analyses SET original_file_name = #{originalFileName}, recognized_total = 0 WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND analysis_status = 'DRAFT' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO receipt_analysis_items ( receipt_analysis_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order ) VALUES
(#{item.receiptAnalysisId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.lineTotal}, #{item.sourceOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE receipt_analyses SET recognized_total = #{recognizedTotal} WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND analysis_status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_analysis_item_id, receipt_analysis_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order FROM receipt_analysis_items WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO receipt_item_allocations ( receipt_analysis_item_id, appointment_member_id, allocated_quantity, allocated_amount ) VALUES
(#{allocation.receiptAnalysisItemId}, #{allocation.appointmentMemberId}, #{allocation.allocatedQuantity}, #{allocation.allocatedAmount})
mapper.update: UPDATE receipt_analyses SET analysis_status = 'ALLOCATED' WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND analysis_status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT ria.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, SUM(ria.allocated_amount) AS allocated_amount FROM receipt_item_allocations ria JOIN receipt_analysis_items rai ON rai.receipt_analysis_item_id = ria.receipt_analysis_item_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = ria.appointment_member_id WHERE rai.receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND ria.deleted_at IS NULL AND rai.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ria.appointment_member_id, am.member_id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_total), 0) FROM receipt_analysis_items WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_items (settlement_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order) SELECT #{settlementId}, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order FROM receipt_analysis_items WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY source_order
mapper.update: UPDATE receipt_analyses SET analysis_status = 'USED' WHERE receipt_analysis_id = #{receiptAnalysisId} AND analysis_status = 'ALLOCATED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_games (settlement_id, game_type, liable_count, game_status) VALUES (#{settlementId}, #{gameType}, #{liableCount}, #{gameStatus})

INSERT INTO settlement_game_members (settlement_id, appointment_member_id, consent_status, is_liable) VALUES
(#{member.settlementId}, #{member.appointmentMemberId}, #{member.consentStatus}, #{member.liable})
mapper.select: SELECT settlement_id, game_type, liable_count, game_status, random_seed FROM settlement_games WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_game_members sgm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sgm.appointment_member_id JOIN settlement_games sg ON sg.settlement_id = sgm.settlement_id SET sgm.consent_status = #{consentStatus}, sgm.responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sgm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sgm.consent_status = 'PENDING' AND sg.game_status = 'WAITING_CONSENT'

UPDATE settlement_games sg JOIN settlements s ON s.settlement_id = sg.settlement_id SET sg.game_status = 'CANCELLED', s.settlement_status = 'CANCELLED', s.canceled_by_member_id = s.created_by_member_id, s.canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.version = s.version + 1 WHERE sg.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sg.game_status = 'WAITING_CONSENT' AND s.settlement_status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE settlement_games SET game_status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND game_status IN ('WAITING_CONSENT', 'READY', 'COMPLETED')
mapper.select: SELECT sgm.settlement_id, sgm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sgm.consent_status, sgm.is_liable AS liable FROM settlement_game_members sgm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sgm.appointment_member_id WHERE sgm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT sgm.settlement_id, sgm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sgm.consent_status, sgm.is_liable AS liable FROM settlement_game_members sgm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sgm.appointment_member_id WHERE sgm.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlements SET settlement_status = 'REQUESTED', payer_share_amount = #{payerShareAmount}, receivable_amount = #{receivableAmount}, requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND settlement_status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE settlement_games SET game_status = 'COMPLETED', random_seed = #{randomSeed}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND game_status = 'WAITING_CONSENT'

UPDATE settlement_members SET request_status = 'PAID', paid_transfer_id = #{transferId}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE settlement_member_id = #{settlementMemberId} AND request_status = 'PENDING' AND paid_transfer_id IS NULL

UPDATE settlements SET settlement_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND settlement_status = 'REQUESTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND request_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL )

UPDATE settlements SET settlement_status = 'CANCELLED', canceled_by_member_id = #{memberId}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND settlement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REQUESTED') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND request_status = 'PAID' )
